items.statement: Molecular hypothesis for the peak-potential differences and its evidential limits

This rule scores the additional physical interpretation, not a second award for the four comparisons. An evidence-backed equivalent explanation passes; bare restatement, generic limitations or speculation without a computed anchor fails. Orbital localization and reduced-anion spin analyses remain optional. A source-supported example is the raised accepting orbital and less favorable reduction of compound 5, whose conjugated framework contains a 4-aminophenyl group and a 6-methoxynaphthalen-2-yl group. Donation and the extended conjugated framework provide a molecular hypothesis; the available comparison does not uniquely separate their contributions or establish the cause of the hydroxy-subseries departures.
